description.en:
Moves the story to a new sub-phase, the step of the story the world reflects, with the objective update presentation.
In order: with _ppsEffFlag it swaps the brightness display (CMND_BRIGHT_SWAP). If the top screen is not already black, it fades the map effects and the screen _scr to black over _fade_out frames. It then replaces the NPCs for the new phase (CMND_NPC_REPLACE), sets the sub-phase (CMND_SET_GAME_SUB_PHASE) and loads the new objective message (CMND_UPDATE_PURPOSE). With _ppsEffFlag it plays the objective effect (PurposeEffect, jingle _jng). It then runs Inatter_Check and waits for the NPC replacement.
If the screen was at normal brightness before and _fade_in is 0 or more, it fades back in over _fade_in frames.
true to play the objective update effect.
Fade-in length in frames; below 0 to stay dark.
